claims.statement: The reviewed revision does not close a rigorous PIFB2 continuum-action theorem; the restricted direct-method target remains incomplete.
open_obligations: Freeze the corrected action and admissible spaces and prove well-definedness, gauge invariance, coercivity or a gauge slice, lower semicontinuity, and boundary closure.
Prove fixed-N lattice-to-continuum convergence and separately construct any claimed continuum probability law.

claims.statement: The pointwise KL expansion is correct, but the global O(h^2) error and exact-ELBO-to-Dirichlet limit need a stated symmetric counting rule and a normalized microscopic construction supplying the h^(d-2) coefficient.
open_obligations: Specify edge orientation, multiplicity, boundaries, interpolation, and covariant transport, then prove the global limit.
Derive the mesh-dependent coefficient from a normalized joint including its normalizers, or restrict the unweighted claim to d equals 2.

claims.statement: The U(1) computation supplies one nontrivial-holonomy separation witness, but the implemented angle statistic is arccos(cos Theta), so it neither equals the U(1) holonomy element nor identifies all distinct holonomies.
open_obligations: Downgrade the prose to an existence witness or add an oriented asymmetric observable and prove its separation class.
